* DOM stands for document object modal.
* This is the representation of all HTML code in the Javascript object form generated by the browser.

* Window is the global object provided by the browser which contains all information about the tab in which the page is loaded. Even the DOM is the property of window object with key document.

* We can manipulate DOM using Javascript and the browser reads that DOM to render the page.

* We can access HTML elements by using the methods given by window object.
- getElementById(): Access HTML element by id attribute.
- getElementsByClassName(): Returns array like structure called HTMLCollection having all elements of the same class attribute.
- getElementsByTagName(): Returns array like structure called HTMLCollection having all element of the specified element.
- querySelector(): Returns the first occurrence of the given CSS selector.
- querySelectorAll(): Returns array like structure called NodeList containing all elements of the given matching CSS selector.
